description: Source-qualified historical certificate presentations. Exact certificate and explicit SPKI reasons remain distinct; material comparison establishes no ownership, deployment continuity or successful authentication. The certificate-object path needs a reported or reproduced whole-certificate witness even in SPKI mode.

source_certificate.description: Actual selected certificate evidence record; a key-only selector does not fabricate a source certificate.

selector.description: Explicit whole-certificate SHA256 selector for ordinary certificate identity, or deliberately selected exact DER SPKI SHA256 comparison. No automatic fallback.

period.description: Analyst/case-selected inclusive UTC dates of candidate presentation; validity, discovery and ingestion are separate.

exclude_mass_managed_source_certificate.description: Explicitly suppress this selected source certificate on supported reported class membership; default retains context.

exclude_cdn_address.description: Explicitly exclude supported CDN-address membership at the presentation's bound address, across IP/FQDN result representation.

purpose.description: These endpoint results require actual presentation; certificate-field names alone do not identify an observed server.

branches.description: Exact whole-certificate identity at an actual supported presentation; names/CT alone never supply presentation.

policies.reason: Explicit selected-source whole-certificate class exclusion using reported membership in supplied revisions; no membership transfer to renewed certificates sharing its key.
Explicit reported IPv4 CDN-class filter, applied to this presentation's evidenced address correspondence across IP/FQDN display; not an origin or service-role assertion.
